note: Recorded NinaPro DB2 subject S10. Recorded channel floors are calibrated from this subject's rest segment. Latency covers feature extraction plus ONNX inference in the worker, measured one window at a time. Windows are pushed in lockstep rather than in real time, so this measures the decode path and not the scheduler. Latency excludes the postMessage round trip and the UI thread: it is what the worker spent, which is the part under the ten-millisecond budget. Signal-quality rejects are counted and excluded from latency percentiles.
